name: Otome ga Irodoru Koi no Essence ~Egao de Orinasu Mirai~
original_name: 乙女が彩る恋のエッセンス ～笑顔で織りなす未来～
source:
This is the fandisc for Otome ga Irodoru Koi no Essence, with after stories for the five heroines and short episodes for sub-heroines Maori and Yakumo. There’s also a secret episode from the perspective of the principal Kotoe.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/11/21/november-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
